evidence: RIKEN Center for Advanced Intelligence Project (AIP)
cells.rationale: Japan has a strong foundation in robotics and industrial automation, translating into solid Computer Vision R&D within major corporations and academic institutions, though perhaps less broad than the US or China.

evidence: KAIST (Korea Advanced Institute of Science and Technology)
cells.rationale: South Korea's tech giants are heavily invested in AI and Computer Vision for consumer electronics, automotive, and robotics. Academic institutions also contribute significantly to advanced research.

evidence: VTT Technical Research Centre of Finland
